Vision & Medical Insurance – Best Eye Exam & Family Eye Care in Uptown Houston, Texas

Having a vision plan and choosing an optometrist who participates in your plan in Uptown Houston, Texas will help you receive the most insurance benefits to pay the least out of pocket for your eye care. At Briargrove Eye Center our eye doctor has excellent credentials and is experienced in family eye care. Our patients are satisfied with their eye exams.

Our Eye Care Staff Is Here To Help You With Your Insurance

Briargrove Eye Center in Uptown Houston, Texas provides eye exams and contact lens eye exams in Uptown Houston, Texas. Briargrove Eye Center accepts most vision insurance plans. We provide expert eye care services. Our office is open on Saturdays from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

If you do not see your plan listed here, please give us a call and we would be happy to assist you. Our staff is also always available to answer any questions regarding your benefits.

The cost of routine eye exams and prescription eyewear can be of real concern, especially for large families. In many cases, vision insurance can lower these annual expenses.

A vision insurance policy is not the same as medical insurance. Regular medical health insurance plans protect you against financial losses due to unexpected eye injuries or disease. Vision insurance, on the other hand, is a wellness benefit designed to provide routine eye care, prescription eyewear and other vision-related services at a reduced cost.
